summary.headline: Theophilus and His Vatican Manuscripts
summary.text: Discussion of Vaticanus 212 and Parisinus 2417, manuscripts preserving Theophilus’s works on military inceptions, including material on wars, diseases, and other affairs. The author assesses Theophilus’s role in preserving Greek astrological writings, transferring the tradition from Syria to Baghdad, and compiling sources on fixed stars and royal or military affairs.
